ENDORSED BYJohn CarlsonNew Haven RTC Chairman"I endorse Peter Lumaj as Secretary of the State for several reasons. To begin with, he has the qualifications required to do the job. His familiarity with law and running a business will no doubt be a huge boon in running SOTS. Secondly, he has the character to ensure the job gets done without bias, and with honesty and integrity. As we’ve seen from recent events, not only in BPT, but elsewhere, we need someone who will take the appointment seriously and without fear of political backlash from any party or backers. “Fear not”, Peter is the candidate who is not afraid to let everyone know what he stands for and what he won’t stand for. Lastly, he is an experienced candidate which will aid him in this run."View all endorsements →
